tools.name: GetTableContents
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve contents (data preview) of an ABAP database table or CDS view. Returns rows of data like SE16/SE16N.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to retrieve

tools.name: GetPackageContents
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve objects inside an ABAP package as a flat list. Supports recursive traversal of subpackages.

package_name.description: Name of the ABAP package (e.g., "ZMY_PACKAGE")

include_subpackages.description: Include contents of subpackages recursively (default: false)

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal (default: 5)

include_descriptions.description: Include object descriptions in response (default: true)

tools.name: GetInclude
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific ABAP include file.

tools.name: GetIncludesList
tools.description: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include.

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP program or include

object_type.description: [read-only] ADT object type (e.g. PROG/P, PROG/I, FUGR, CLAS/OC)

detailed.description: [read-only] If true, returns structured JSON with metadata and raw XML.

timeout.description: [read-only] Timeout in ms for each ADT request.

tools.name: GetEnhancements
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve a list of enhancements for a given ABAP object.

tools.name: GetEnhancementSpot
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve metadata and list of implementations for a specific enhancement spot.

tools.name: GetEnhancementImpl
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific enhancement implementation by its name and enhancement spot.

tools.name: GetTransport
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transport request information including metadata, included objects, and status from SAP system.

include_objects.description: Include list of objects in transport (default: true)

include_tasks.description: Include list of tasks in transport (default: true)

tools.name: ListTransports
tools.description: [read-only] List transport requests for the current or specified user. Returns modifiable and/or released workbench and customizing requests.

user.description: SAP user name. If not provided, returns transports for the current user.

modifiable_only.description: Only return modifiable (not yet released) transports. Default: true.

tools.name: GetProgFullCode
tools.description: [read-only] Returns the full code for a program or function group, including all includes, in tree traversal order.

name.description: [read-only] Technical name of the program or function group (e.g., '/CBY/MM_INVENTORY')

type.description: [read-only] 'PROG/P' for program or 'FUGR' for function group

tools.name: ReadClass
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: Class. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating class. [read-only] Read ABAP class source code and metadata. Answers: "show class code", "display class source", "view class definition/implementation", "get class X". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadInterface
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: Interface. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating interface. [read-only] Read ABAP interface source code and metadata. Answers: "show interface code", "display interface definition", "view interface X", "get interface source". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadProgram
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: Program. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating program. [read-only] Read ABAP program (report) source code and metadata. Answers: "show program code", "display report source", "view program X", "get program source". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadTable
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: Table. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating table. [read-only] Read ABAP table definition and metadata. Answers: "show table fields", "display table structure", "view table X", "get table definition". Returns field list, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadStructure
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: Structure. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating structure. [read-only] Read ABAP structure definition and metadata. Answers: "show structure fields", "display structure X", "view structure definition", "get structure components". Returns field list, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadView
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: View. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating view. [read-only] Read ABAP CDS view source code and metadata. Answers: "show CDS view source", "display view definition", "view CDS X", "get CDS code". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadDomain
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: Domain. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating domain. [read-only] Read ABAP domain definition and metadata. Answers: "show domain X", "display domain fixed values", "view domain definition", "get domain properties". Returns definition, fixed values, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadDataElement
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: DataElement. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating data element. [read-only] Read ABAP data element definition and metadata. Answers: "show data element X", "display data element properties", "view DTEL definition", "get data element type". Returns definition, domain, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadFunctionModule
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: FunctionModule. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating function module. [read-only] Read ABAP function module source code and metadata. Answers: "show function module code", "display FM source", "view function X", "get function module implementation". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

function_group_name.description: Function group name containing the function module (e.g., Z_MY_FG).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadFunctionGroup
tools.description: [read-only] Read ABAP function group source code and metadata. Answers: "show function group code", "display FUGR source", "view function group X", "get function group includes". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadPackage
tools.description: [read-only] Read ABAP package definition and metadata. Answers: "show package X", "display package properties", "view package contents", "get package info". Returns definition, super-package, responsible, description.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., Z_MY_PACKAGE).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadServiceDefinition
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: ServiceDefinition. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating service definition. [read-only] Read ABAP service definition (SRVD) source code and metadata. Answers: "show service definition", "display SRVD source", "view service definition X", "get service exposure". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadMetadataExtension
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: MetadataExtension. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating metadata extension. [read-only] Read ABAP metadata extension (DDLX) source code and metadata. Answers: "show metadata extension", "display DDLX source", "view UI annotations", "get metadata extension X". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadBehaviorDefinition
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: BehaviorDefinition. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating behavior definition. [read-only] Read ABAP RAP behavior definition (BDEF) source code and metadata. Answers: "show behavior definition", "display BDEF source", "view RAP behavior X", "get behavior definition code". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadBehaviorImplementation
tools.description: [read-only] Read ABAP RAP behavior implementation source code and metadata. Answers: "show behavior implementation", "display behavior pool code", "view RAP implementation X". Returns source code, package, responsible, description.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: ReadServiceBinding
tools.description: Operation: Read, Create, Update. Subject: ServiceBinding. Will be useful for reading, creating, or updating service binding. [read-only] Read ABAP service binding (SRVB) payload and metadata. Answers: "show service binding", "display SRVB config", "view service binding X", "get OData service binding". Returns payload, package, responsible, description.

tools.name: GetTypeInfo
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP type information for domains (DOMA), data elements (DTEL), table types, and structures. Returns field definitions, value ranges, fixed values, and DDIC metadata.

include_structure_fallback.description: When true (default), tries DDIC structure lookup only if type lookup returns 404/empty.

tools.name: GetTransaction
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transaction (t-code) details — program, screen, authorization object, and transaction type (dialog, report, OO).

tools.name: RuntimeCreateProfilerTraceParameters
tools.description: [runtime] Create ABAP profiler trace parameters and return profilerId (URI) for profiled execution.

description.description: Human-readable trace description.

tools.name: RuntimeListProfilerTraceFiles
tools.description: [runtime] List ABAP profiler trace files available in ADT runtime. Returns parsed JSON payload.

tools.name: RuntimeGetProfilerTraceData
tools.description: [runtime] Read profiler trace data by trace id/uri: hitlist, statements, or db accesses. Returns parsed JSON payload.

trace_id_or_uri.description: Profiler trace ID or full ADT trace URI.

tools.name: RuntimeGetDumpById
tools.description: [runtime] Read a specific ABAP runtime dump by its ID. First use RuntimeListFeeds to find dumps and get their IDs, then pass dump_id here to read the full dump content.

dump_id.description: Full runtime dump ID (e.g. from RuntimeListFeeds).

view.description: Dump view mode: default payload, summary section, or formatted long text.

response_mode.description: Controls what is returned: "payload" — full parsed dump data, "summary" — compact key facts only (title, exception, program, line, user, date…), "both" — summary + full payload.

tools.name: RuntimeRunClassWithProfiling
tools.description: [runtime] Execute ABAP class with profiler enabled and return created profilerId + traceId.

description.description: Profiler trace description.

tools.name: RuntimeRunProgramWithProfiling
tools.description: [runtime] Execute ABAP program with profiler enabled and return created profilerId + traceId.

description.description: Profiler trace description.

tools.name: RuntimeAnalyzeProfilerTrace
tools.description: [runtime] Read profiler trace view and return compact analysis summary (totals + top entries).

trace_id_or_uri.description: Profiler trace ID or full trace URI.

top.description: Number of top rows for summary. Default: 10.

tools.name: RuntimeListFeeds
tools.description: [runtime] List available ADT runtime feeds or read a specific feed type. Feed types: dumps, system_messages, gateway_errors. Without feed_type returns available feed descriptors.

feed_type.description: Feed to read. "descriptors" lists available feeds, "variants" lists feed variants, others read that specific feed. Default: descriptors.

user.description: Filter feed entries by SAP username.

max_results.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

from.description: Start of time range in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format.

to.description: End of time range in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format.

tools.name: RuntimeListSystemMessages
tools.description: [runtime] List SM02 system messages. Returns structured entries with id, title, text, severity, validity period, and author.

max_results.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

from.description: Start of time range in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format.

to.description: End of time range in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format.

tools.name: RuntimeGetGatewayErrorLog
tools.description: [runtime] List SAP Gateway error log (/IWFND/ERROR_LOG) or get error detail. Returns structured entries with type, shortText, transactionId, dateTime, username. With error_url returns full detail including serviceInfo, errorContext, sourceCode, callStack.

error_url.description: Feed URL of a specific error entry (from a previous list response link field). When provided, returns detailed error info instead of listing.

max_results.description: Maximum number of errors to return.

from.description: Start of time range in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format.

to.description: End of time range in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format.

tools.name: GetSqlQuery
tools.description: [read-only] Execute ABAP SQL SELECT queries on database tables and CDS views via SAP ADT Data Preview API. Use for ad-hoc data retrieval, row counts, and filtered queries.

row_number.description: [read-only] Maximum number of rows to return

tools.name: GetWhereUsed
tools.description: [read-only] Search where-used references — find all objects that reference or depend on a given ABAP object. Answers: "where is X used", "who calls X", "what depends on X", "show usages of X". Supports classes, interfaces, tables, data elements, programs, function modules, etc. Returns referencing objects with types and packages.

object_type.description: Type of the ABAP object (class, interface, program, table, etc.)

enable_all_types.description: If true, searches in all available object types (Eclipse 'select all' behavior). Default: false (uses SAP default scope)

tools.name: GetObjectInfo
tools.description: [read-only] Return ABAP object tree structure for packages (DEVC), classes (CLAS), programs (PROG), function groups (FUGR), and other objects. Shows root, group nodes, and terminal leaves up to maxDepth. Enrich each node with description and package via SearchObject if enrich=true.

parent_type.description: [read-only] Parent object type (e.g. DEVC/K, CLAS/OC, PROG/P)

maxDepth.description: [read-only] Maximum tree depth (default depends on type)

enrich.description: [read-only] Whether to add description and package via SearchObject (default true)

tools.name: GetAbapAST
tools.description: [read-only] Parse ABAP code and return AST (Abstract Syntax Tree) in JSON format.

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

tools.name: GetAbapSemanticAnalysis
tools.description: [read-only] Perform semantic analysis on ABAP code and return symbols, types, scopes, and dependencies.

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

tools.name: GetAbapSystemSymbols
tools.description: [read-only] Resolve ABAP symbols from semantic analysis with SAP system information including types, scopes, descriptions, and packages.

code.description: ABAP source code to analyze and resolve symbols for

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

tools.name: GetSession
tools.description: [read-only] Get a new session ID and current session state (cookies, CSRF token) for reuse across multiple ADT operations. Use this to maintain the same session and lock handle across multiple requests.

force_new.description: Force creation of a new session even if one exists. Default: false

tools.name: GetInactiveObjects
tools.description: [read-only] Get a list of inactive ABAP objects — modified but not yet activated, pending activation. Shows classes, tables, CDS views, and other objects awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetAdtTypes
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve all valid ADT object types (CLAS, TABL, PROG, DEVC, FUGR, INTF, DDLS, DTEL, DOMA, SRVD, SRVB, BDEF, DDLX, etc.) or validate a specific type name.

tools.name: GetObjectStructure
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ADT object structure as a compact JSON tree.

tools.name: GetObjectNodeFromCache
tools.description: [read-only] Returns a node from the in-memory objects list cache by OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_NAME, TECH_NAME, and expands OBJECT_URI if present.

tools.name: DescribeByList
tools.description: [read-only] Batch description for a list of ABAP objects. Input: objects: Array<{ name: string, type?: string }>. Each object may be of type: PROG/P, FUGR, PROG/I, CLAS/OC, FUGR/FC, INTF/OI, TABLE, STRUCTURE, etc.

name.description: [read-only] Object name (required, must be valid ABAP object name or mask)

tools.name: GetVirtualFoldersLow
tools.description: [low-level] Retrieve hierarchical virtual folder contents from ADT information system. Used for browsing ABAP objects by package, group, type, etc.

preselection.description: Optional preselection filters (facet-value pairs for filtering)

values.description: Array of facet values to filter by

facet_order.description: Order of facets in response (e.g., ["package", "group", "type"]). Default: ["package", "group", "type"]

tools.name: GetNodeStructureLow
tools.description: [low-level] Fetch node structure from ADT repository. Used for object tree navigation and structure discovery. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

node_id.description: Optional node ID (default: "0000" for root). Use to fetch child nodes.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

tools.name: GetObjectStructureLow
tools.description: [low-level] Retrieve ADT object structure as compact JSON tree. Returns XML response with object structure tree. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

tools.name: GetPackageTree
tools.description: [high-level] Retrieve complete package tree structure including subpackages and objects. Returns hierarchical tree with object names, types, and descriptions.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., "ZMY_PACKAGE")

include_subpackages.description: Include subpackages recursively in the tree. If false, subpackages are shown as first-level objects but not recursively expanded. Default: true

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal. Default: 5

include_descriptions.description: Include object descriptions in response. Default: true

debug.description: Include diagnostic metadata in response (counts, types, hierarchy info). Default: false

tools.name: ActivateObjects
tools.description: Activate one or multiple ABAP repository objects. Use after Create/Update when objects remain inactive, or for group activation of related objects (e.g., domains + data elements + tables together). Works with any object type.

name.description: Object name in uppercase (e.g., ZOK7_D_MTART, ZCL_MY_CLASS)

type.description: Object type code: DOMA (domain), DTEL (data element), TABL (table), STRU (structure), DDLS (CDS view), CLAS (class), INTF (interface), PROG (program), FUGR (function group), FUGR/FF (function module), TTYP (table type), SRVD (service definition), SRVB (service binding), BDEF (behavior definition), DDLX (metadata extension), DCLS (access control), ENHO (enhancement)

objects.description: Array of objects to activate. Each object must have 'name' and 'type'.

preaudit.description: Request pre-audit before activation. Default: true

tools.name: ActivateDomain
tools.description: Activate an ABAP domain. Use after CreateDomain or UpdateDomain if the object remains inactive.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

tools.name: CreatePackage
tools.description: Create a new ABAP package in SAP system. Packages are containers for development objects and are essential for organizing code.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_TEST_0002). Must follow SAP naming conventions (start with Z or Y for customer namespace).

description.description: Package description. If not provided, package_name will be used.

super_package.description: Parent package name (e.g., ZOK_PACKAGE). Required for structure packages.

software_component.description: Software component (e.g., HOME, ZLOCAL). If not provided, SAP will set a default (typically ZLOCAL for local packages).

transport_layer.description: Transport layer (e.g., ZE19). Required for transportable packages.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required if package is transportable.

record_changes.description: Enable change recording for the package. Required for transportable packages. Default: false.

tools.name: GetPackage
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP package metadata (description, super-package, etc.). Supports reading active or inactive version.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., Z_MY_PACKAGE).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: CreateDomain
tools.description: Operation: Create. Subject: Domain. Will be useful for creating domain. Create a new ABAP domain in SAP system. Creates the domain object in initial state.

domain_name.description: Domain name (e.g., ZZ_TEST_0001). Must follow SAP naming conventions.

description.description: (optional) Domain description. If not provided, domain_name will be used.

package_name.description: (optional) Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: (optional) Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

datatype.description: (optional) Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: (optional) Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

conversion_exit.description: (optional) Conversion exit routine name (without CONVERSION_EXIT_ prefix)

value_table.description: (optional) Value table name for foreign key relationship

activate.description: (optional) Activate domain after creation (default: true)

fixed_values.description: (optional) Array of fixed values for domain value range

text.description: Description text for the fixed value

tools.name: GetDomain
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP domain definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: UpdateDomain
tools.description: Operation: Update, Create. Subject: Domain. Will be useful for updating or creating domain. Update an existing ABAP domain. Locks, updates with provided parameters (complete replacement), unlocks, and optionally activates.

description.description: New domain description (optional)

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

datatype.description: Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

conversion_exit.description: Conversion exit routine name (without CONVERSION_EXIT_ prefix)

value_table.description: Value table name for foreign key relationship

activate.description: Activate domain after update (default: true)

fixed_values.description: Array of fixed values for domain value range

text.description: Description text for the fixed value

tools.name: DeleteDomain
tools.description: Delete an ABAP domain from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

tools.name: CreateDataElement
tools.description: Operation: Create. Subject: DataElement. Will be useful for creating data element. Create a new ABAP data element in SAP system. Creates the data element object in initial state.

data_element_name.description: Data element name (e.g., ZZ_E_TEST_001). Must follow SAP naming conventions.

description.description: Data element description. If not provided, data_element_name will be used.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

data_type.description: Data type (e.g., CHAR, NUMC) or domain name when type_kind is 'domain'.

length.description: Data type length. Usually inherited from domain.

decimals.description: Decimal places. Usually inherited from domain.

short_label.description: Short field label (max 10 chars). Applied during update step after creation.

medium_label.description: Medium field label (max 20 chars). Applied during update step after creation.

long_label.description: Long field label (max 40 chars). Applied during update step after creation.

heading_label.description: Heading field label (max 55 chars). Applied during update step after creation.

tools.description: Retrieve ABAP behavior implementation definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: UpdateBehaviorImplementation
tools.description: Update source code of an existing ABAP behavior implementation class. Updates both main source (with FOR BEHAVIOR OF clause) and implementations include. Uses stateful session with proper lock/unlock mechanism.

class_name.description: Behavior Implementation class name (e.g., ZBP_MY_ENTITY). Must exist in the system.

behavior_definition.description: Behavior Definition name (e.g., ZI_MY_ENTITY). Must match the behavior definition used when creating the class.

implementation_code.description: Implementation code for the implementations include. Contains the actual behavior implementation methods.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Optional if object is local or already in transport.

activate.description: Activate behavior implementation after update. Default: true.

tools.name: DeleteBehaviorImplementation
tools.description: Delete an ABAP behavior implementation from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

tools.name: CreateMetadataExtension
tools.description: Operation: Create. Subject: MetadataExtension. Will be useful for creating metadata extension. Create a new ABAP Metadata Extension (DDLX) in SAP system. Creates the metadata extension object in initial state.

description.description: Description

package_name.description: Package name

transport_request.description: Transport request number

activate.description: Activate after creation. Default: true

tools.name: GetMetadataExtension
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP metadata extension definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: UpdateMetadataExtension
tools.description: Operation: Update, Create. Subject: MetadataExtension. Will be useful for updating or creating metadata extension. Update source code of an existing ABAP Metadata Extension (DDLX). Locks, updates, unlocks, and optionally activates.

lock_handle.description: Lock handle from LockObject. If not provided, will attempt to lock internally.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable packages).

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: true

tools.name: DeleteMetadataExtension
tools.description: Delete an ABAP metadata extension from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

tools.name: CheckBehaviorDefinition
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP behavior definition (BDEF). Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

tools.name: CheckClass
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP class. Can check existing class (active/inactive) or validate hypothetical source code. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

version.description: Version to check: 'active' (last activated) or 'inactive' (current unsaved). Default: active.

source_code.description: Optional: source code to validate. If provided, validates hypothetical code without creating object. Must include complete CLASS DEFINITION and IMPLEMENTATION sections.

tools.name: CheckDataElement
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP data element. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

tools.name: CheckDomain
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP domain. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

tools.name: CheckFunctionGroup
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP function group. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

tools.name: CheckFunctionModule
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP function module. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

function_group_name.description: Function group name containing the function module.

version.description: Version to check: 'active' or 'inactive'. Default: active.

tools.name: CheckInterface
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP interface. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

tools.name: CheckMetadataExtension
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP metadata extension (DDLX). Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

tools.name: CheckPackage
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP package. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZMY_PACKAGE).

tools.name: CheckProgram
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP program. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages. Not available on cloud.

tools.name: CheckStructure
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP structure. Can check existing structure (active/inactive) or validate hypothetical DDL code. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

version.description: Version to check: 'active' or 'inactive'. Default: inactive.

ddl_code.description: Optional: DDL source code to validate instead of the saved version.

tools.name: CheckTable
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP table. Can check existing table (active/inactive) or validate hypothetical DDL code. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

version.description: Version to check: 'active', 'inactive', or 'new'. Default: new.

ddl_code.description: Optional: DDL source code to validate instead of the saved version.

tools.name: CheckView
tools.description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP CDS view. Can check existing view (active/inactive) or validate hypothetical DDL source. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

version.description: Version to check: 'active' or 'inactive'. Default: inactive.

ddl_source.description: Optional: DDL source code to validate instead of the saved version.

tools.name: SearchObject
tools.description: [read-only] Search ABAP repository by object name or wildcard pattern (e.g. 'ZOK*'). Answers: "find object X", "does X exist", "list objects matching...", "search for program/class/table by name". Supports all repository object types — optionally filter by type (PROG, CLAS, INTF, DEVC, TABL, DDLS, DTEL, FUGR, SRVD, SRVB, BDEF, DDLX, etc.).

maxResults.description: [read-only] Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: GetObjectsList
tools.description: [read-only] Recursively retrieves all child ABAP repository objects for a given parent — programs (PROG), function groups (FUGR), classes (CLAS), packages (DEVC), and other composite objects — including nested includes and subcomponents.

tools.name: GetObjectsByType
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieves all ABAP objects of a specific type (classes, tables, programs, interfaces, etc.) under a given parent node. Useful for listing all objects of one type within a package or composite object.
